description: This file defines an EventEmitter class implementing event handling with support for asynchronous handlers, listener management, and leak detection, used within the Playwright core project.

classes.name: EventEmitter
classes.description: A custom event emitter class supporting synchronous and asynchronous event handlers, with features like max listener limits and leak warnings.

classes.name: OnceWrapper
classes.description: A helper class to wrap listeners for 'once' event handling, ensuring they are invoked only once.

methods.name: setMaxListeners
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of listeners for the emitter.

methods.name: getMaxListeners
methods.description: Retrieves the current maximum number of listeners.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Emits an event of a given type, invoking all associated listeners.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a new listener for a specific event type.

methods.name: prependListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to the beginning of the listeners array for a specific event.

methods.name: once
methods.description: Adds a one-time listener for a specific event.

methods.name: prependOnceListener
methods.description: Adds a one-time listener to the beginning of the listeners array.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a specific listener for an event.

methods.name: removeAllListeners
methods.description: Removes all listeners for a specific event or all events.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Returns an array of listeners for a specific event.

methods.name: rawListeners
methods.description: Returns an array of all listeners, including wrappers, for a specific event.

methods.name: listenerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of listeners for a specific event.

methods.name: eventNames
methods.description: Returns an array of event names with registered listeners.
